overview_description.description:
CAN Capital provides capital to small and medium-sized businesses, using its own real-time platform and risk-scoring models.


Its Daily Remittance Platform allows lenders to access the daily cash flows of borrowers, and collect daily remittances from them. The platform gives lenders a window into their customers’ daily business, and relies on payment processors to split the settlement of card transactions between the small business and its bank.


CAN Capital, Inc. was formerly known as Capital Access Network, Inc. and changed its name to CAN Capital, Inc. in December 2013. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in New York, United States.
